subject: Biology
text: Osmosis is the net movement of ___ molecules across a partially permeable membrane from a region of higher water concentration to lower.
explain: Osmosis is the movement of water molecules across a partially permeable membrane.

subject: Physics
text: Calculate the potential difference across a 5 ohm resistor carrying a current of 3 A (include unit).
explain: Potential difference V = I x R = 3 A x 5 ohm = 15 V.
